reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Our new system replaces the single cost chip with a detailed Materials sheet for each build tile. No more guessing what resources you need! Now, you can see stored vs required materials, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change makes planning your colony's construction much easier. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Materials Instead of Cost Badges Update
steam.body: We are thrilled to announce a major update to Provincia! The new Materials system replaces the previous cost badges, providing a clear view of all required resources for each build. You can now easily track what materials you have versus what you need, with shortages highlighted for better planning. This update enhances your gameplay experience and makes building your colony more intuitive. Read more about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
